question_text: An international organisation is
option_a: An organisation whose membership and activities span more than one country

question_text: Which of the following is an international organisation?
option_a: United Nations
explanation: The UN is an international organisation.

The main aim of the United Nations is
option_a: To maintain international peace and security
explanation: The UN maintains international peace and security.

question_text: One function of the United Nations is
option_a: Promoting human rights

question_text: The United Nations Conference on Trade and Development was established to
option_a: Promote international trade and development

question_text: One function of UNCTAD is
option_a: Promoting trade between developed and developing countries
explanation: UNCTAD promotes trade between developed and developing countries.

The main aim of the World Trade Organisation is
option_a: To promote free and fair international trade

option_a: Administering trade agreements

question_text: The main aim of the International Monetary Fund is
option_a: To promote international monetary cooperation and exchange rate stability

question_text: One function of the International Monetary Fund is
option_a: Providing short-term balance of payments support to member countries
explanation: The IMF gives short-term balance of payments support.

question_text: The main aim of the World Bank is
option_a: To provide long-term loans for development projects
explanation: The World Bank funds long-term development.

question_text: One function of the World Bank is
option_a: Providing long-term loans for infrastructure

question_text: The main aim of the International Finance Corporation is
option_a: To finance private sector projects in developing countries
explanation: The IFC finances private sector projects.

question_text: The main aim of the African Development Bank is
option_a: To finance development projects in African countries

question_text: One function of the African Development Bank is
option_a: Providing loans for infrastructure in Africa

option_b: A single currency for all Africa

option_a: To promote unity and cooperation among African states

question_text: One function of the African Union is
option_a: Promoting peace and security in Africa
explanation: The AU promotes peace and security.

option_a: Stabilising oil prices in the international market

question_text: The European Union is a
option_a: Regional economic and political union of European states
explanation: The EU is a European regional union.

question_text: One function of the European Union is
option_a: Creating a single market among member states
explanation: The EU creates a single market.

question_text: One feature of the European Union is
option_a: A common currency (the euro) for most members
explanation: Most EU members use the euro.

question_text: The North American Free Trade Agreement was an agreement among
option_a: The United States, Canada and Mexico
explanation: NAFTA involved the US, Canada and Mexico.

question_text: NAFTA aimed to
option_a: Remove trade barriers among member countries

question_text: Mercosur is a trade bloc in
option_a: South America
explanation: Mercosur is a South American trade bloc.

question_text: One aim of a regional trade bloc is
option_a: To promote trade among member countries

question_text: One advantage of a regional trade bloc is
option_a: Larger markets for members

question_text: One disadvantage of a regional trade bloc is
option_a: It may discriminate against non-members
explanation: Trade blocs may discriminate against outsiders.

question_text: A common market is one in which
option_a: Member countries allow free movement of goods, services, capital and labour
explanation: Common markets allow free movement of all factors.

question_text: A customs union is one in which
option_a: Member countries remove internal tariffs and adopt a common external tariff
option_b: Member countries keep their own tariffs
explanation: Customs unions have a common external tariff.

question_text: A free trade area is one in which
option_a: Member countries remove tariffs among themselves but keep their own external tariffs
option_b: Member countries adopt a common external tariff
explanation: Free trade areas abolish internal tariffs only.

question_text: One difference between a free trade area and a customs union is that
option_a: A customs union has a common external tariff while a free trade area does not
explanation: Customs unions have common external tariffs.

question_text: One benefit of international trade organisations to Nigeria is
option_a: Access to larger markets
explanation: Trade organisations give Nigeria larger markets.

question_text: One challenge of international trade organisations to Nigeria is
option_a: Loss of some economic sovereignty

question_text: The main aim of the International Labour Organisation is
option_a: To promote social justice and fair labour standards
explanation: The ILO promotes fair labour standards.

question_text: One function of the International Labour Organisation is
option_a: Setting international labour standards

question_text: The main aim of the World Health Organisation is
option_a: To promote international public health

question_text: One function of the World Health Organisation is
option_a: Coordinating international health responses

question_text: The main aim of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation is
option_a: To promote education, science and culture

question_text: One function of UNESCO is
option_a: Promoting education worldwide

question_text: The main aim of the Food and Agriculture Organisation is
option_a: To eliminate hunger and improve nutrition

option_a: Providing agricultural technical assistance

option_a: To protect the rights and welfare of children

question_text: One function of the United Nations Children's Fund is
option_a: Providing humanitarian aid to children

question_text: The main aim of the United Nations Development Programme is
option_a: To help countries develop and reduce poverty

question_text: One function of the United Nations Development Programme is
option_a: Providing technical assistance for development

question_text: The main aim of the International Court of Justice is
option_a: To settle legal disputes between states
explanation: The ICJ settles legal disputes between states.

question_text: The main aim of the International Criminal Court is
option_a: To try individuals for international crimes
explanation: The ICC tries individuals for international crimes.

option_a: The ICJ hears disputes between states while the ICC tries individuals

option_a: To harmonise customs procedures among member countries
